00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000010.title: Prologue: The first map
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000010.synopsis: Years before the letter, a father and his small daughter draw the island together, and he tells her the one rule of cartography that matters.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000010.notes: Short. This is the memory every later chapter bends around. End on the pencil.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000036.title: Interlude – Sixty-one
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000036.synopsis: Father Quill, alone, counts the bell. A one-page interlude between the second and third parts.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000036.notes: Standalone piece filed loose in Manuscript, ordered between two Part folders.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000011.title: Epilogue: Where we left it
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000011.synopsis: A year later Mara draws the island for the last time and leaves the northern shore blank on purpose. Tomas takes her back to the mainland; the island stays where she put it.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000011.notes: Mirror the prologue. She keeps the rule and breaks it in the same gesture.
